The '''Maktite''' were a group of soldiers and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. They tried to defeat the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]]<ref name="CSWE" /> some time prior to [[3956 BBY]];<ref name="KOTOR" /> however, like other groups that followed, they were unsuccessful. They were unprepared to counter the military equipment developed by the Echani,<ref name="CSWE" /> who made several simple yet elegant changes to their [[Echani light armor|light armor]] which rendered the Maktite [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal weapons]] ineffective.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Maktite were first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|computer roleplaying game]] produced by [[BioWare]] in [[2003]]. They never appear in the game but are mentioned in the description of the Echani light armor, which are also available in the sequel, ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', produced in [[2004]]. The item description is also included in the two [[Prima Games]] strategy guides. They also received a mention in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
